title: Verdant 45 — Walls & Roofs: RPG Maker MZ A3 + A4 Sheets, 16 Buildings and 24 Walls [16x16]
shortText: RPG Maker MZ A3 + A4 pages: 16 roofs, 16 walls, 24 wall tops, 24 faces. Plus Tiled + Godot. 16x16.
description:
The A3 and A4 pages for RPG Maker MZ, in the Verdant series' 16x16 pixel-art look: 16 roofs and 16 building walls on the A3 sheet, 24 wall tops and 24 wall faces on the A4 sheet, upscaled exactly 3x to MZ's 48px. Commercial use permitted in unlimited projects, no attribution required; you may not resell the tiles themselves as an asset pack.

Walls and buildings that MZ paints for you

Drop the two PNGs into img/tilesets, set them as A3 and A4 in a Tileset, and MZ's own brush draws every corner, edge and end as you paint: a cottage, a castle wall that turns a corner, a cliff with a notch in it. Keep your own A2 floors and B-E objects beside them, from any Verdant pack or your own.

We placed both sheets in a blank MZ project, wired them into the Tileset data, saved a map painted with every shape of every set, and ran that project's own autotile drawing code on every cell: 2,048 of 2,048 cells came out identical to the tiles in this download. The RPG Maker MZ editor itself was not opened.

What is in it

  • A3, 16 buildings: thatch over daub and timber, shakes over boards, slate over ashlar, dark tiles over red brick, pantiles over sandstone, kawara over shoji, terracotta over whitewash, a striped fair stall, a gilt sky palace, a station module, a desert house, a tenement, a snowbound lodge, a turf croft, a toadstool house and an infernal citadel.
  • A4, 24 walls: meadow, snow and desert cliffs, a hedge, a root bank, ice, cloud and spore ledges; castle, ruin, dungeon, sewer, cave, crystal, infernal and mire walls; palace, office, clinic, school, prison, station, kaido and foundry interiors.
  • 2,024 loose 16x16 tiles: every shape of all 80 sets, each tagged in tiles.json with its MZ page, slot and shape number, plus Tiled .tsx files and a Godot 4 TileSet.
  • A 40x26 sample map as PNG and JSON: nine houses, a town wall, a castle wall with a gate, a plateau and hedges. Its grass, cobbles, doors, windows and chimneys are from Verdant 09 — Town, and the map says so.

Made from the series

Every wall and roof is built over a fill from an existing Verdant pack, re-generated by that pack's own code (26 packs), so a building matches the ground it stands on: Verdant 09 — Town's thatch and daub, Verdant 10 — Harbour's slate and ashlar, Verdant 13 — Castle's curtain wall and walkway, Verdant 16 — East Asian's kawara and shoji. This pack still stands alone: everything it needs is in the download.

Engines

  • RPG Maker MZ: every block of both sheets rebuilt from the loose tiles, and all 2,048 of 2,048 shapes composed back out of the sheets by MZ's own autotile drawing code, taken from the engine's source and run.
  • Tiled: four .tsx files, every tile drawn by Tiled's own renderer and compared with the sheets.
  • Godot 4: one TileSet, loaded and verified in Godot 4.7.2 (2,024 tiles built). Tiled and Godot get every shape as a separate tile; no terrain rules are set up for you.

The proofs

Every tile's wrap boundary is measured against its own interior, and every 4x4 repetition is rendered and reviewed. Grid, palette and autotile completeness are machine-proven: every tile is exactly 16x16, every pixel is inside the 145-colour palette, alpha is strictly on or off, and every set carries every shape (16 for walls and roofs, 47 for wall tops).

AI disclosure

Every tile is generated by our own procedural drawing engine, which is AI-written software. No image model, no scraped art and no training dataset were used, and nothing was traced.
